notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.16 and §4.14.5 public-API witness for the Enumerated Data Type Name rule at p. 94 l. 66 and p. 72 l. 124. A valid-name control FOM is first accepted through public Create; the schema-valid negative FOM differs only by a period in the enumerated data type name and must be rejected as InconsistentFOM. This demonstrates the period restriction only, not every HLA naming rule, all enumerated-data-type fields, arbitrary FOMs, or conformance.
